summary: Tested the events feature and document types on backend and frontend. Backend: 30/30 pytest pass, covering the new test_events_doctypes.py (14 tests) and the legacy test_institutions_documents.py, which I updated to send the now-required doc_type. Frontend: almost everything works. Header: nav-esemenyek shows at 1280, the mobile menu takes over at 1279 and 390, and there is no horizontal overflow. /esemenyek: 7 filter buttons; institution filters show that institution's events plus 'all' events; the upcoming list is ascending; the past event (Tanévnyitó) is grey and opens no popup on hover or click. The popup shows title, date, location, institution and description; it opens after 250ms of hover, on click and on Enter. X, Esc and leaving the card close it. Home: 3 upcoming events, no I–VIII/1861 stats, view-all goes to /esemenyek, hover opens the popup. Member pages are scoped correctly. Admin: created an event (all, 14:30), edited it (kisbaconi-ovoda, time cleared) and it showed up on the public pages, then deleted it. Documents: upload is blocked until a type is chosen, the per-row type select sends PATCH 200, and the /kozlemenyek filter and badges are correct. RO switch is correct throughout. One UX bug: the event popup immediately reopens when it is closed while the cursor is over an upcoming row.

ui_bugs.issue: The popup reopens about 250ms after closing with Esc or a backdrop click if the cursor is over an upcoming event row. A hover-opened popup usually leaves the cursor over the row, so a click on the backdrop just outside the card reopens it, and it can be hard to dismiss. Reproduced: hover Mikulás row, wait, press Esc: 0 popups at +60ms, 1 again at +660ms. Backdrop click over the Karácsonyi row: popup reopens. A popup also opens on its own when a page loads or scrolls and a row lands under a resting cursor. RCA: when the overlay unmounts, the browser fires mouseenter on the row now under the cursor, which starts the 250ms open timer again. Fix: in EventList, keep a 'suppress until real mouseleave' flag (or about a 400ms cooldown) after onClose. Also only arm the timer on a real mousemove over the row, not on mouseenter caused by layout or scroll.

action_items: Fix the event popup reopening after Esc or backdrop close while the cursor is over a row (EventList.tsx): ignore the row mouseenter that follows a close, until a real mouseleave or mousemove.
critical_code_review_comments: EventsManager: delete has no confirm dialog, while DocumentsManager asks for confirmation. A misclick removes an event right away. The remove mutation has no onError toast.
EventsManager: save onError shows the generic contact error text, not the backend 422 detail (for example 'Invalid date or time').
Past/upcoming is decided by the client's local date, while the backend has no notion of it. Fine for a Romania-only audience.
GET /api/events has no limit or pagination, and old events accumulate. Consider keeping only the recent past events on the public pages over time.
